verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing lets ops build transaction rules and relayed authorization logic to approve/decline in real time, and provides card suspend/close controls plus a Raise Disputes API for cardholders to report fraud or lost cards — covering blocking and dispute workflows. However there is no evidence of network fraud scores or Adyen's own risk models surfaced at auth time, no mention of suspicious-activity alerting, and no explicit card-reissue tooling (only activate/suspend/close). missing for 10: fraud-score/model signals at authorization, proactive suspicious-activity alerts, dedicated reissue flow for compromised cards.
